Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 80
- main street road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: alley entrance mid-block; parking: parallel street parking both sides
- two-story brick commercial building at left block face, 2 stories, red brick, cast iron storefront columns, flat parapet roof, at sidewalk setback
- single-story retail building at center block face, 1 story, brick, plate glass storefront, flat with low parapet roof, at sidewalk setback
- corner mixed-use building at right corner, 3 stories, brick, stone trim cornice, flat roof, at sidewalk setback
- utilities: overhead power and telephone lines, wooden utility poles every 50 feet — keep their exact positions and geometry, but render them as period-appropriate infrastructure for the target year
- landscape: concrete sidewalks, brick pavers at crosswalks
- immutable elements: cast iron storefront columns on left building, recessed corner entrance on right building, brick alley mid-block
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2025
Post-pandemic era. A 2025 main street — minimalist flat-logo storefronts, QR codes on the glass, delivery culture in plain view.

CONDITION: abandoned — closed business, boarded windows, weeds through pavement cracks, weathered surfaces

PERIOD DETAILS
- every storefront closed and dark — no lit signs, no menu boards, no open businesses
- faded remains of old signage still on the facade, lettering weathered and partly missing
- plywood over the ground-floor windows, doors chained shut
No sign text anywhere except weathered remnants — do not turn words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
NO people anywhere — the place is completely deserted.

VEHICLES
NO vehicles anywhere — empty lot, no parked or moving cars.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: worn and faded, well past their last repainting
- utilities: overhead power lines still on the original poles along the street, fiber optic bundles and 5G small cell nodes mounted on the existing poles

DECAY
- rust streaks below the old cornice bolts
- plywood over a broken transom window, the glass long gone
- a collapsed awning frame hanging loose over the sidewalk
Wear is surfaces only — road, curbs, footprints, camera unchanged.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — digital — smartphone or mirrorless camera look.
Color: high saturation. Grain: very clean, minimal to no noise.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
